description: Schema for packages/targets/codex/features.json — the SSOT for which codex [features] flags the harness declares and which it removes from live configs. settingsSync keys/removeKeys are derived from this table.

measuredWith.description: codex-cli version the defaults were measured against (e.g. 'codex-cli 0.153.4'). Defaults drift between releases, so record what was measured.

notes.description: Why this table exists and how to re-measure it.

features.description: Feature name -> declaration. Every codex feature the harness has an opinion about, including ones it deliberately does not declare.

stage.description: Stage reported by `codex features list`. 'absent' means the flag no longer exists in the measured version and is kept only to retire it from live configs.

default.description: Effective value with an empty CODEX_HOME. Required unless stage is 'absent'.

shape.description: Form the codex parser accepts. Required unless stage is 'absent'.

fields.description: Sub-keys accepted by a table-shaped flag. codex rejects unknown fields by failing the whole config load, so this must match the parser exactly.

declare.description: true: written to config.toml and synced (becomes a settingsSync key). false: never written and removed from live configs (becomes a removeKey).

why.description: Reason for the declare decision, in the author's own words.
